race.title: Denis O'Connell Memorial Veterans' Handicap Chase
race.verdict: This looks wide open so a chance is taken on KNAPPERS HILL off his reduced mark given his excellent record fresh. Git Maker is another to consider down in class, while Tom Lacey holds a strong hand with last year's winner Nocte Volatus and Pounding Poet , who's had little racing over fences despite his veteran status. KNAPPERS HILL (IRE) GIT MAKER (FR) NOCTE VOLATUS
race.bettingForecast: The Boola Boss (4/1), Sure Touch (9/2), Git Maker (5/1), Nocte Volatus (11/2), Knappers Hill (6/1), Pounding Poet (6/1), Iron Bridge (7/1), Docpickedme (12/1), Hang In There (16/1)
